game_concept: A strategy race set in Mt. Pyre – Molten Bridge, a bridge over magma: the ember mage must handle magma slimes while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Parenthesis Puzzle: Place parentheses to make an expression equal the number carved on the cooling vent.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Molten Bridge: a bridge over magma
core_gameplay_loop: In Molten Bridge, repeat each round: Place parentheses to make an expression equal the number carved on the cooling vent. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the ember mage ahead. Then check the puzzle_gap value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the cooling vent by solving code steps involving puzzle_gap that move the ember mage forward.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.5).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the cooling vent first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 1 (intro tier): Parenthesis Puzzle
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Parenthesis Puzzle' (Week 2 slot 9), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Molten Bridge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how puzzle_gap changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against magma slimes in Molten Bridge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.5).
